```{ojs}
md`<div class="cs-lead">Staff per student at public colleges <b>fell or held flat from 2000 to 2012</b>, mostly in non-faculty staff, <b>then rose</b>. From FY2013 to FY2024 the typical surviving college added <b>${f1(K.rise_fac_unw)}</b> log points of faculty FTE per student and <b>${f1(K.rise_nonfac_unw)}</b> of non-faculty FTE per student (${f1(K.rise_fac_w)} and ${f1(K.rise_nonfac_w)} counting every employee and student together). Most of that is the denominator: enrollment fell ${f1(-K.fte_dlog_unw)} points while faculty FTE fell ${f1(-K.staff_fac_unw)} and non-faculty FTE ${f1(-K.staff_nonfac_unw)}.</div>`
```

## By sector

```{ojs}
viewof sx = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Faculty and non-faculty FTE per 1,000", "pk"], ["FT faculty per 1,000", "ftf"], ["Headcount per 1,000 (v1)", "hc"], ["Enrollment", "fte"]]), {value: param("k", "pk"), label: "Show"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("k", sx === "pk" ? null : sx);
  const SG = {pr: "pr", pm: "rp", pb: "rp", cc: "cc", xr: "xr", xm: "xmb", xb: "xmb"};
  const el = (k, m) => EL.find(d => d.sg === SG[k] && d.base === "b1987" && d.outcome === m && d.main === 1);
  const pc = (a, b) => s0(100 * (b / a - 1)) + "%";
  return html`<div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th rowspan="2">Sector</th>
    <th colspan="3">Faculty FTE per 1,000</th><th colspan="3">Non-faculty FTE per 1,000</th><th rowspan="2">Fall FTE<br>FY2012–24</th><th rowspan="2">Staffing elasticity<br>faculty / non-faculty<br>(sector group)</th></tr>
    <tr><th>FY2000</th><th>FY2013</th><th>FY2024</th><th>FY2000</th><th>FY2013</th><th>FY2024</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${SECTORS.map(s => { const a = el(s.k, "facfte"), b = el(s.k, "nonfacfte"); const weak = a && a.fs_F < 20; return html`<tr><td><span class="sw" style="background:${s.c}"></span>${s.l}</td>
      <td>${f0(K[`fpk_${s.k}_2000`])}</td><td>${f0(K[`fpk_${s.k}_2013`])}</td><td><b>${f0(K[`fpk_${s.k}_2024`])}</b> <span class="cs-note">(${pc(K[`fpk_${s.k}_2013`], K[`fpk_${s.k}_2024`])})</span></td>
      <td>${f0(K[`npk_${s.k}_2000`])}</td><td>${f0(K[`npk_${s.k}_2013`])}</td><td><b>${f0(K[`npk_${s.k}_2024`])}</b> <span class="cs-note">(${pc(K[`npk_${s.k}_2013`], K[`npk_${s.k}_2024`])})</span></td>
      <td>${s0(K[`fte_${s.k}_12_24`])}%</td>
      <td>${a && b ? `${f2(a.coef)} / ${f2(b.coef)}${weak ? " (weak)" : ""}` : "–"}</td></tr>`; })}</tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
{
  const m = sx === "pk" ? PAIR : sx === "ftf" ? ["ftfac"] : sx === "hc" ? ["total"] : null;
  if (!m) {
    return html`<p class="cs-note">Enrollment trends by sector and peer group are on the <a href="../enrollment/index.html">Enrollment</a> page.</p>`;
  }
  const pts = TR.filter(d => m.includes(d.m) && d.fy >= 1990).map(d => ({...d, lab: SECL[d.sec], e: BRK.has(d.m) ? era(d.fy) : "a"}));
  const dom = [0, d3.max(pts, d => d.unw) * 1.03];
  const ends = spreadLabels(SECTORS.flatMap(s => m.map(mm => { const l = pts.filter(d => d.sec === s.k && d.m === mm).at(-1); return {x: l.fy, y: l.unw, label: `${s.l}${m.length > 1 ? (mm === "facfte" ? " (fac.)" : " (non-fac.)") : ""} ${f0(l.unw)}`}; })), {domain: dom, height: 380, gap: 11});
  return html`${Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 900), height: 380, marginRight: width < 600 ? 10 : 190, marginLeft: 44,
    x: {...yearAxis}, y: {grid: true, domain: dom, label: m.length > 1 ? "Faculty FTE (solid) and non-faculty FTE (dashed) per 1,000 FTE students" : `${MEASL[m[0]]} per 1,000 FTE students`},
    color: {domain: SECTORS.map(s => s.l), range: SECTORS.map(s => s.c), legend: width < 600},
    marks: [Plot.rectX([{a: 1989.5, b: 2012.5}], {x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: SHADE}),
      m.some(x => BRK.has(x)) ? Plot.ruleX([2012.5], {stroke: BREAKC, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}) : null,
      ...m.map(mm => Plot.lineY(pts.filter(d => d.m === mm), {x: "fy", y: "unw", z: d => d.sec + d.e, stroke: "lab", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: m.length > 1 ? PAIRDASH[mm] : null})),
      width < 600 ? null : Plot.text(ends, {x: "x", y: "ly", text: "label", dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 9.5, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "unw", title: d => `${d.lab}, FY${d.fy}\n${MEASL[d.m]}: ${f1(d.unw)}`}))]
  })}${m.length > 1 ? html`<p class="cs-note">${pairNote}</p>` : ""}`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
Staff per 1,000 fall FTE students, S24 surviving set (1,909 institutions), mean of institution ratios; shaded years are those covered by the 2014 Delta Cost brief. FTE staff = full-time + one-third of part-time; faculty excludes graduate assistants. Changes are from FY2013, the first year of the redesigned IPEDS staff survey (part-time faculty are spliced there, and community-college non-faculty FTE steps up about 1 log point (part-time staff)). Faculty FTE and non-faculty FTE per 1,000 rose in every sector except private research non-faculty. Enrollment change: sector totals, S24. Elasticity: two-stage least squares of faculty FTE and of non-faculty FTE on fall FTE using the gravity population instrument (county base 1987); public master's and bachelor's colleges are pooled as regional publics, private master's and bachelor's colleges are pooled. Private-sector first stages are weak. Every number on this page is listed with its source file and column in [kpis.csv](../data/kpis.csv). Data: IPEDS (FY2024–25 NCES provisional), SEER population, BLS LAUS, EADA.
:::
